membership_note: scenario_ids are sorted membership; ordered_scenario_ids are the fixed trial positions 1-10. Existing v1 set IDs and memberships are preserved.
selection_note: Choose uniformly from the 324 sets and run ordered_scenario_ids exactly as stored. Never reshuffle. Save the chosen set once per session; rerendering must not redraw it.
ordering_rules: At most two consecutive completed or incomplete trials.
At most two consecutive trials with the same behavior condition.
Each half (1-5 and 6-10) contains two or three completed trials.
Each half contains one no-behavior, two tapping, and two banging trials.
Each half contains one completed trial requiring no prompts.
